title: Vault Lifecycle States and Approval Governance

scope.purpose: Govern the meaning, promotion, approval, supersession, and auditability of Vault lifecycle states for manufacturing data.
scope.boundary: Lifecycle governance is normative; detailed Vault configuration, permissions implementation, and deployment remain downstream configuration or instruction content.

requirements.statement: Governed Vault content shall use lifecycle states with explicit meanings and transition authority sufficient to distinguish work in progress, review, release, supersession, and archival conditions.
New governed manufacturing content shall begin in a non-released working state and shall pass through the required review and approval route before release.
The original author shall not self-approve release where the governed approval route requires independent approval.
Release transitions shall record the responsible approval authority and sufficient audit evidence to establish who released the content and when.
Superseded or archived content shall remain distinguishable from currently released content, and supersession shall identify the applicable replacement or successor where one exists.

Only content in an authorized released condition shall be eligible for normal downstream manufacturing, BIM coordination, or project publication unless a governed exception explicitly permits otherwise.

governance_note: Autodesk Vault permits lifecycle names and transitions to be configured. The source state vocabulary is therefore a governed organizational pattern, not a claim that these exact names are immutable product defaults.

provenance.source_title: S9 – Vault Lifecycle States & Approval Governance
provenance.migration_note: Migrated lifecycle meaning, segregation of duties, release eligibility, supersession, and audit requirements. Configuration mechanics remain outside normative authority.
